saocFooter.why: The Explore and Partners lists use FOOTER_RHYTHM.list (no gap: Partners' gap-2 goes) and every row (Explore links, Partners names, the WOSA link) starts with FOOTER_RHYTHM.row. The skin classes after it are BASE's, minus the four the shared row now carries (inline-flex, min-h-11, items-center, text-[14px]); links keep min-w-11 (44px target). The headings, the column gap-3 and the Stay in touch blocks are untouched: BASE already spaces each heading 16px from its first row (mb-1 4px + gap-3 12px), the handoff kit's 16px.

nosFooter.why: Content-pinned (F1 and F3 rebuild this file): the two lists take nf-list plus FOOTER_RHYTHM.list, the Explore link, the Partners name and the WOSA link take FOOTER_RHYTHM.row. NOS type and colour stay in nos-chrome.css.

rules: .nf-list a, .nf-list span { line-height: 1.35; color: var(--nc-lilac); text-decoration: none; }
.nf-wild a { color: var(--nc-ground); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--nc-green-1); text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
nosCss.why: nos-chrome.css is unlayered, so its rules beat Tailwind's layered utilities: the row geometry and size come off .nf-list a/span and .nf-wild a (display, align-items, min-height, font-size 15px, the span's padding-block 11px) and off .nf-list (display: grid) so FOOTER_RHYTHM applies; NOS colour, line-height and underline stay. The column headings (div.nf-head) get the 16px bottom margin. F1's sign-up label (label.nf-head) keeps .nf-head's 6px, SAOC's label mb-1.5 (Codi FINAL 2026-10-22, the height ruling); F1 R3 compares the label's type with the heading's, not its margin.

handoff.note: src/styles.css:1108 .footer__label says margin-bottom: 18px; the ruling names 16px, which is the UI kit's value.
